title: Native metadata import boundary and persisted OIDC/transport qualification
classification: Confirmed legacy-framework import regression fixed; obsolete session/keyring/transport test preconditions repaired

environment.database: Owned loopback PostgreSQL 17.6 plus disposable SQLite for framework-blocked probes and OIDC login storage

verification.coverage: Framework-free imports/startup, blocked-framework authenticated bootstrap, Steam metadata mapping in Flask-compatible database scopes, Steam bounded retries, native OIDC PKCE/state/nonce/subject behavior, setup encrypted selected credentials, outbound redirect policies and redacted failures.
verification.oidc_identity: Real mapped user and persistent-login records; independent logins have distinct valid random-secret identities for the same user/fingerprint, and remember cookies match their session identity. No TESTING bypass was enabled to pass the native login.
verification.transport: Redirect checks still execute safe_request; interception covers actual caller-owned requests.Session transport. Retry unit checks mock the safe_request dependency and assert its validator wiring. No provider delivery occurred.
verification.cleanup: All owned PostgreSQL databases removed (matching count verified zero); SQLite probe engines disposed.
verification.warnings: One existing Flask-Login UTC deprecation warning

root_causes: Steam metadata imported the legacy database extension at module import. Use the existing native_db facade, whose session delegates to Flask only when needed at runtime.
Cold probes used old short identities without persistent rows or setup tables; provide a real owned native engine, synthetic model row, completed setup and issued identity.
OIDC fakes supplied no persisted mapped user/session; preserve the normal callback issuer path with a real test row rather than disabling persistent sessions.
Selected-credential setup writes need their explicit temporary keyring and encrypted representation assertions.
Legacy transport mocks patched module get/request functions while bounded connectors now own Session instances; intercept the actual boundary without bypassing redirect validation.
rework: First cold-probe store lacked the user/setup tables required by normal setup gating; added owned rows and matching fingerprint before the final pass.
An overlapping standalone/combined cold-probe subset was run during adjacent qualification; its cases are not counted again.
The first broader adjacent metadata run exposed another stale requests.get retry mock; corrected that mock before final qualification.
limitations: This is focused native/compatibility qualification, not full-route parity, a real identity-provider connection or installed-image/platform acceptance.
The historical 24-module diagnostic ended at 34 failed/420 passed/2 skipped with cleanup; this slice repairs a subset and does not claim the rest resolved.
Preliminary 10/23/24-case selections overlap the final 120 and must not be added to it.
Current CI/full unrestricted Python/coverage and original review/release/deployment gates remain open.
capture: Not applicable: backend import ownership, test fixtures and documentation; no UI layout changes.
